news.title: Samantha Ruth Prabhu Balances Fitness Routine and Fresh Wins
news.summary: Following the success of Maa Inti Bangaram, Samantha Ruth Prabhu is staying active and sharing glimpses of her workout routine involving tennis and gym sessions. She continues to document her personal journey weekly while also showcasing stylish looks in between her active schedule.

news.title: Akhira Nandan Shares a Special Moment with Nani After The Paradise Box Office Milestone
news.summary: Young actor Akhira Nandan posted a photo with Nani to celebrate his role as 'Chota Jadal' in The Paradise. The film crossed the Rs. 155 crore mark globally, marking Nani's biggest first weekend collection to date.

news.title: Allu Sirish Clarifies Stance Following Backlash Over Temple Noise Complaint
news.summary: Actor Allu Sirish addressed online criticism after complaining to police about late-night DJ music at a Hanuman temple in his Shaikpet neighborhood. He emphasized that his grievance was strictly about civic rules and late-night noise disturbances rather than religious devotion.

news.title: Income Tax Officials Conduct Searches at Properties Linked to Rakul Preet and Vashu Bhagnani
news.summary: Income Tax department teams carried out raids across multiple Mumbai properties associated with actress Rakul Preet Singh, producer Vashu Bhagnani, and Panorama Studios. The searches were initiated over suspected tax evasion and unauthorized financial transfers abroad related to film production expenses.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Gears Up for OTT Debut with Netflix Talk Show
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi is set to anchor Netflix's premier celebrity talk show tailored for an international audience. Backed by his daughter Sushmita Konidela, the podcast-style program will mark a brand-new digital milestone in the veteran actor's illustrious career.

news.title: Why Music Sensation Sai Abhyankkar is Holding Back on Telugu Signings
news.summary: Rising composer Sai Abhyankkar has quickly captured attention in South Indian cinema with consecutive chartbusters. Sources indicate he has agreed not to sign any other Telugu projects until the release of his debut film, Allu Arjun and Atlee's Raaka.

news.title: Kiran Abbavaram Nears Completion of Directorial Venture KA13
news.summary: Actor-director Kiran Abbavaram is approaching the final shooting schedule of his upcoming project, KA13. The film features Devika Bhat alongside veteran actors Sarath Kumar and Sai Kumar, with the official title expected to be revealed shortly.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Smashes Records in Northern Markets
news.summary: Natural Star Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, has pulled off an impressive Rs. 7.2 crore nett in the Hindi belt during its opening weekend, easily outpacing the lifetime numbers of his past projects in the region. Directed by Srikanth Odela and backed by SLV Cinemas, the action drama also crossed a massive Rs. 155 crore globally in its initial days.

news.title: The Paradise Enters Elite Overseas Club as North American Collections Soar
news.summary: Nani's box office dominance continues to grow internationally as his latest vehicle, The Paradise, officially crossed the $2 million threshold in North America. This milestone marks another major achievement for the actor in the overseas territory, aided by strong ticket sales and high anticipation.

news.title: Strong Overseas Momentum Propels Nani's The Paradise Past Major Milestones
news.summary: Despite a mixed public talk upon release, the Srikanth Odela directorial has sprinted past the $2 million mark in North America by the end of its first weekend. With global earnings nearing the Rs. 150 crore milestone, the SLV Cinemas production stands tall as the actor's biggest box office venture to date.

news.title: Karthi's Sardar 2 Locks Digital Premiere Date on Amazon Prime
news.summary: Following its theatrical arrival on September 10, 2026, actor Karthi's action drama Sardar 2 is swiftly making its transition to the digital space. Amazon Prime Video has officially confirmed that the multi-language release will begin streaming on October 1, 2026.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Set to Host a Digital Podcast on Netflix
news.summary: Legendary actor Chiranjeevi is reportedly collaborating with Netflix for a multi-episode podcast series instead of a traditional documentary format. The conversational show will feature the veteran star sharing personal life stories, industry struggles, and memorable milestones from his illustrious career. Produced by his daughter Sushmita Konidela, the venture marks an exciting digital debut for the actor.

news.title: Tollywood Faces a Growing Shortage of Dedicated Writers
news.summary: The Telugu film industry is experiencing a critical shortfall of specialized writers, with many directors attempting to handle storytelling themselves. Industry critics note that this trend often harms a film's overall narrative strength and box-office potential. Experts suggest adopting models seen in other regional industries, such as Malayalam cinema, where dedicated writers spearhead projects before onboarding directors.

news.title: Karthik Subbaraj's Dorothy Gears Up for Telugu Release
news.summary: Director Karthik Subbaraj's upcoming Tamil drama Dorothy, starring Keerthy Suresh in the lead, is scheduled for a Telugu dubbed release on October 2. The film explores bold themes including toxic masculinity, patriarchy, and LGBTQ+ narratives set in rural Tamil Nadu. Industry observers are keen to see how Telugu audiences will receive the movie's unconventional elements and storyline.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Collects Rs. 155 Crore in Opening Weekend
news.summary: Srikanth Odela's directorial venture The Paradise, starring Nani in the lead, has raked in a massive worldwide gross of Rs. 155 crore over its first weekend. Despite drawing mixed audience reviews and a slower Sunday collection, the pan-Indian project successfully crossed the $2 million milestone in North America. Trade analysts are now closely monitoring the film's performance during the crucial weekday box office run.

news.title: Happy Journey Sustains Momentum in Theaters
news.summary: Directed by Abhiramm Naidu, the film Happy Journey has accumulated a gross collection of 5.41 crores over its 10-day theatrical run. Following a sluggish initial opening, the movie experienced a noticeable boost in footfall over its second weekend. Family audiences have responded warmly to the lighthearted narrative and emotional elements.

news.title: Balakrishna Suggests Script Adjustments for Mokshagna's Launch
news.summary: Nandamuri Balakrishna is closely overseeing the script for his son Mokshagna's upcoming debut film directed by Mallidi Vasishta. After listening to the complete narration, the actor suggested specific modifications to the second half. The project aims to introduce the debutant in a distinctive format rather than a standard commercial actioner.

news.title: Allu Sirish Sparks Debate Over Late-Night Temple Noise
news.summary: Actor Allu Sirish drew mixed online responses after filing a complaint with Hyderabad police regarding loud music played late at night from a neighborhood temple. While some internet users echoed his concerns about noise pollution, others questioned the selective nature of his grievance. Local authorities have initiated steps to look into the matter.

news.title: Janhvi Kapoor Adopts a Strategic Career Strategy
news.summary: Actress Janhvi Kapoor is reportedly exercising greater caution in selecting her upcoming film roles following her appearance in Peddi. She is actively seeking out performance-driven characters rather than routine commercial parts. Meanwhile, unconfirmed reports have linked her to Allu Arjun's upcoming movie Raaka.

news.title: Zarina Wahab's Emotional Glimpse Unveiled from Puri Jagannadh's Slum Dog
news.summary: The makers of Puri Jagannadh's directorial venture Slum Dog: 33 Temple Road have released a special promotional clip focusing on veteran actress Zarina Wahab. Portraying a character named Zubeidaa, the video captures her heartbreaking monologue about resorting to begging due to dire circumstances. The action-packed drama stars Vijay Sethupathi alongside Tabu and Samyuktha, with music scored by Harshavardhan Rameshwar.

news.title: Hindi Television Premiere Date Confirmed for Ram Charan's Peddi
news.summary: Director Buchi Babu Sana's action drama Peddi, starring Ram Charan and Janhvi Kapoor, is heading to the small screen in Hindi. Sony MAX has scheduled the television broadcast of the Vriddhi Cinemas production for October 25, 2026. Meanwhile, discussions regarding the film's Telugu TV premiere point towards a possible festive telecast on ZEE Telugu.

news.title: Character Promo Highlights Zarina Wahab's Poignant Role in Slum Dog - 33 Temple Road
news.summary: Marking Puri Jagannadh's birthday, the production team of Slum Dog - 33 Temple Road revealed an emotionally resonant teaser featuring Zarina Wahab as Zubeidaa. The snippet showcases the stark realities of hunger and poverty through a powerful performance by the veteran star, complemented by Harshavardhan Rameshwar's background score. The pan-Indian venture also features an ensemble cast including Tabu and Samyuktha in pivotal roles.

news.title: Rag Mayur's Anumanam Pakshi Fails to Impress at the Box Office
news.summary: Small-budget release Anumanam Pakshi, starring Rag Mayur and marking Merin Philip's Telugu debut, faced a major washout following its September 25 release. Overshadowed by Nani's high-profile film The Paradise, the Chilaka Productions venture suffered from negative reviews and extremely low theater occupancy. The poor audience turnout marks another setback for the banner after struggling to find traction in cinemas.

news.title: Netflix sets October premiere for Romanchakam
news.summary: Sandeep Reddy Vanga's backed romantic comedy Romanchakam is heading to Netflix on October 1, 2026. Directed by Venu Gopal Reddy, the youthful drama features Sumanth Prabhas and Ananthika Sanilkumar in lead roles. The multilingual digital release aims to give the film a fresh audience following its theatrical run.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise smashes box office records with massive opening weekend
news.summary: Nani and Srikanth Odela's action drama The Paradise has crossed Rs 138 crore worldwide in its opening weekend, emerging as the highest-grossing film of the actor's career. Despite facing mixed reactions online, the movie dominated the box office and crossed the $2 million mark in North America.

news.title: The Paradise powers through negative chatter to achieve career-best numbers for Nani
news.summary: Srikanth Odela's directorial venture The Paradise has set a new benchmark for lead actor Nani by pulling in robust numbers despite online trolling. The multilingual feature collected massive grosses globally over its first few days, easily surpassing the lifetime totals of his previous movies.

news.title: Raja Kumari turns composer for upcoming film Impure
news.summary: Acclaimed artist Raja Kumari is stepping into film scoring by co-composing the music for Impure alongside Karan Pandav. Directed by Nishanthi Evani, the bold social comedy is slated for a theatrical release on October 2.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's AK47 Unveils Peppy Opening Track
news.summary: The inaugural single titled 'Narayanamma' from the upcoming family entertainer 'Aadarsha Kutumbam House No.47 – AK47', starring Victory Venkatesh and directed by Trivikram Srinivas, has been officially released. Composed by Thaman S and featuring energetic vocals along with a special visual appearance by Dimple Hayathi, the festive track sets a lively tone for the movie. Sridevi Shetty and Nivetha Pethuraj also appear in the song's vibrant video visuals.

news.title: Veteran Actress Zarina Wahab Joins Puri Jagannadh and Vijay Sethupathi's Pan-India Project
news.summary: Puri Jagannadh and Vijay Sethupathi's collaborative action drama 'Slum Dog' has introduced veteran actress Zarina Wahab as Zubaida. Produced under Puri Connects and JB Motion Pictures, the pan-India venture also features an ensemble cast including Tabu, Samyuktha, and Duniya Vijay. The film is slated for release across five different languages.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Eyes Big Weekend Numbers Amid Negative Reviews
news.summary: Despite opening to mixed critiques and social media trolling, Nani's latest movie is drawing solid crowds, particularly in Telangana. Trade analysts project the film will comfortably surpass the ₹150 crore gross milestone during its opening weekend. The upcoming weekday box-office performance will serve as the true test of the actor's box-office stamina.
